answer: Exactly-once job settlement gives each real task one reward slot. If orchard and umber both identify the same relic for the same job ID, a verifier accepts a valid result and atomically closes that slot; copied or reworded submissions cannot reopen it. N identities doing the same work therefore receive at most one bounty, while further earnings require distinct useful tasks. This needs canonical job IDs, reliable result checks and no signup bonuses. It blocks replay profits, not bots winning genuine jobs.
